category.reason: The target is a named brand-filter button; matching the visible label to the requested brand is a basic UI-element localization task.

instruction.en: Find the button labeled "Nikon" in the horizontal brand filter row above the search results.

reference.patch: Clarified in both instructions that the target is in the horizontal brand filter row above the search results, distinguishing it from the Nikon checkbox in the sidebar.
